title: Wildlife Conservation Society Application
titleZh: 野生动物保护协会申请

parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Section one. You will hear a man inquiring about joining a wildlife conservation society.

1st, you have some time to look at questions one to 6 on page two.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to 6.

Wildlife Conservation Society. Good afternoon. Can I help you?

Oh, hello. Uh, yes, I'd like to join, please.

Oh, yes, certainly. I'll just get some details from you. Could I have your name?

Michael Jones.

Right. And can I ask where you heard about us? Was it in an advert, or did a friend tell you, or-

Neither, actually. It was a radio program. Then I just got your number from the phone book.

Oh, right.

Uh, now I need some membership details. It's Michael Jones. And the address?

21 Beale Street.

Okay.

Leeds.

Fine. And do you know your postcode?

Yes, it's, uh, LS14 2JW.

Okay. And do you have a daytime telephone number we can contact you on?

Yes, you can call me at work. The number is oh, double one-73-58-642. And I can give you my office email address if you like.

That'd probably be useful. Yes, please.

It's mj@hennings.co.uk.

Is that H-E-double N-I-N-G-S?

That's right.

Thank you.

Now, I just need to ask you some questions about exactly what you want. 1st of all, how long do you want the membership for? We do two, three, and five-year memberships, and we also do one for life.

Uh, I think I'll just get the minimum length this time around.

Fine. And then the type of membership. We do single, joint, or family, which covers up to 4 children.

Well, we haven't got any children, but I think I'll get the joint one because my wife will probably want to do the activities with me.

Yes, fine.

Let me see. That'll be 49 pounds altogether then, please.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10 on page two.

Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.

How would you like to pay?

Uh, by direct debit.

No problem. I just need your bank details. Can you give me the name 1st?

It's the Union Bank.

And now I've got your name, but I need your account number.

Uh, uh, 01-05-96-12.

Okay. When would you like to start payment? Next month on the 1st of October, or...

Can you make it the 15th instead?

No problem. The membership will begin then, too. Is that all right?

That's fine.

I'll just give you a reference number in case there's any problem. Have you got a pen?

Uh, yes.

It's JYZ37. And we'll be sending you an information pack within a few days. Is there anything else?

Uh, oh, yes. Could you send me an additional one? I've got a friend who's very interested.

Certainly, no problem. I'll make a note of that. There's also a video we can send you if you like. There's no charge.

Yes, please. That'll be great.

That is the end of Section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音中工作人员询问你是从哪里得知他们的，男士回答说既不是广告也不是朋友，而是一个广播节目（radio program）。
你可能听到选项里有“advert”或者“friend”就想直接填，但男士紧接着用“Neither”否定了这两个干扰项，并在之后才给出了正确答案。
And can I ask where you heard about us? Was it in an advert, or did a friend tell you, or- Neither, actually. It was a radio program. Then I just got your number from the phone book.
录音中工作人员询问邮编，男士直接报出了对应的字母和数字组合“LS14 2JW”。
这道题你容易在字母和数字的连读上出错，特别是J和W的读音容易混淆，听到这种信息点必须马上提笔记下清晰的发音。
And do you know your postcode? Yes, it's, uh, LS14 2JW.
男士给出了他的办公邮箱“mj@hennings.co.uk”，随后工作人员用“H-E-double N-I-N-G-S”进行了拼写确认。
你可能会漏听“double N”导致拼写少写一个n，在听到对方念字母拼写时，一定要在纸上同步核对写下来的每一个字母。
It's mj@hennings.co.uk. Is that H-E-double N-I-N-G-S? That's right. Thank you.
工作人员列举了两年、三年、五年和终身的会员时长，男士表示自己这次只要“minimum length”（最短时长），对应的也就是刚才列出的最短选项“两年”。
录音中给出了多个数字作为干扰（2, 3, 5），如果你只是单纯找数字，没有把“minimum”（最短）和上文的“two”结合起来理解，就会填错。
1st of all, how long do you want the membership for? We do two, three, and five-year memberships, and we also do one for life. Uh, I think I'll just get the minimum length this time around.
工作人员给出了三种会员类型（single, joint, family），男士明确表示想办“joint one”（联合会员），因为妻子想和他一起参加活动。
你可能会听到“children”这个词就急着写family，但其实男士说“haven't got any children”（没有孩子）直接排除了家庭会员。

And then the type of membership. We do single, joint, or family, which covers up to 4 children. Well, we haven't got any children, but I think I'll get the joint one because my wife will probably want to do the activities with me. Yes, fine.
工作人员在确认完会员类型后，直接计算并给出了总费用“49 pounds”（49英镑）。
这是一道直给的数字题，你唯一容易犯的错误就是把“49”的尾音没听清，错填成读音相近的“40”或“90”。
Let me see. That'll be 49 pounds altogether then, please.
工作人员询问银行的名称，男士直接回答是“Union Bank”。
直接听写题最怕拼错，你要确保听清发音并正确拼出“Union”，不要把它写成发音相似却毫无意义的错误单词。
I just need your bank details. Can you give me the name 1st? It's the Union Bank.
工作人员提议10月1日开始，但男士反问能否改为“15th”（15号），工作人员随后同意了该日期。
如果你听到工作人员先说出的“1st of October”就立刻写答案并不再往下听，就会直接掉进干扰陷阱。
When would you like to start payment? Next month on the 1st of October, or... Can you make it the 15th instead? No problem. The membership will begin then, too. Is that all right? That's fine.
工作人员说要给一个参考号（reference number），并在男士准备好笔后，报出了正确的字母数字组合“JYZ37”。
字母“J”和“Z”的发音是这道题最大的混淆点，你极有可能会跟“G”或“C”搞混，平时需要大量练习相似字母的听写反应。
I'll just give you a reference number in case there's any problem. Have you got a pen? Uh, yes. It's JYZ37.
在处理完额外信息包的请求后，工作人员主动提出还可以免费寄送一个“video”（视频），男士表示了同意。
题干上已经列出了“extra information pack”，所以你不能把男士前面提到要额外多要一份的“additional one”当成答案，必须往后听找到并列的全新事物。
There's also a video we can send you if you like. There's no charge. Yes, please. That'll be great.
